caption: The drawing depicts a wooden corner cabinet mounted on the walls of a room. The cabinet is rectangular in shape with a slightly projecting top cornice and features a single door with vertical and horizontal panels carved into the surface. The wood of the cabinet is colored a reddish-brown, indicating a polished or varnished wood finish. The cabinet door includes a round knob on the left side and a visible keyhole below it, as well as a hinge on the right edge. The walls of the room are paneled with rectangular designs and painted a muted blue, while the baseboards at the bottom corner of the room are a darker reddish-brown color similar to that of the cabinet. The floor is an off-white or beige color, matching the background of the entire drawing. The overall composition is geometric, with lines defining the architectural structure of the corner where the cabinet is installed.
title: Shaker Small Corner Cupboard
